requirements.optional_promoted_features: storageBuffer16BitAccess, samplerYcbcrConversion and variablePointersStorageBuffer are optional when their respective extensions are unsupported. requirements.subgroups: Compute queues require COMPUTE supported stage and BASIC operation set, with a nonzero power-of-two subgroup size. Arithmetic/vote/ballot/shuffle/quad are additional optional sets.
requirements.spirv: Vulkan1.1 must support SPIR-V1.0/1.1/1.2/1.3 plus GLSL.std.450 1.0. Capability support remains conditional on the Vulkan feature/extension table. Existing parser availability and a few accepted modules do not establish complete legal environment coverage.
requirements.compute_only: No blanket claim that graphics queue absence itself prohibits Vulkan1.1. Also no blanket exemption of graphics-looking property minima from the normal required-limits table.
